text: Grab has never declared or paid any cash dividend on its Class A Ordinary Shares and currently intends to retain future earnings, with no dividends expected in the foreseeable future [Grab, FY2025, p.122, 123]. Any future decision to pay dividends would be at the discretion of its board of directors, subject to applicable laws, and would depend on factors such as Grab's financial condition, results of operations, capital requirements, general business conditions, and other factors the board may deem relevant [Grab, FY2025, p.122, 123].

answer: Grab has never declared or paid any cash dividend on its Class A Ordinary Shares and currently intends to retain future earnings, with no dividends expected in the foreseeable future [Grab, FY2025, p.122, 123]. Any future decision to pay dividends would be at the discretion of its board of directors, subject to applicable laws, and would depend on factors such as Grab's financial condition, results of operations, capital requirements, general business conditions, and other factors the board may deem relevant [Grab, FY2025, p.122, 123].
